description: Snowflake connector. Indexes Snowflake databases/schemas/tables (column names + tags only, NEVER row data) as `snowflake:data_model` items in the local index and exposes read tools (`snowflake_list`, `snowflake_get`, `snowflake_search`) plus HITL-gated governance write tools (`snowflake_tag_set`, `snowflake_comment_set`). Uses the Snowflake SQL REST API (`POST /api/v2/statements`) with OAuth token or key-pair JWT auth. The account identifier is supplied via the `snowflake.account` vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddSnowflakeMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty.
